style.loanwords_text: Common technical loanwords (e.g. blockchain, wallet, bridge) may remain in Latin script where that is the natural Simplified Chinese usage; do not force awkward coinages.
style.notes:
Reviewer (register): neutral
Reviewer (numerals): western
Reviewer (decimal_separator): .
Reviewer (quotes): ""
Reviewer (abbreviations_with_full_stop): .

wallet.context: 钱包 as standalone term; keep English in product names (e.g. Nym Mixnet Wallet Setup → keep English)

pool.context: keep English as standalone term; translate as 池 in compounds (e.g. Shielded Pools → 屏蔽池)

node.inflection: It is NOT a loanword: use the translated term in compounds and plurals too.
